_note: No variant passed every workload, so these have no T_b anchor. Triage before the manifest is cut -- a problem without an anchor is not scoreable and must be counted as such.

shard._note: Produced by one shard of a card-pinned partition: plan[index::count] over the sorted plan, a pure function of the problem name, so every replicate of a problem lands on the same card. COVERAGE IS A PROPERTY OF THE MERGED OUTPUT DIRECTORY, NOT OF ONE SHARD -- run scripts/check_coverage.py --artifacts <out> only after all `count` shards have finished.
